# Junk Shop attribution and license notice

The Junk Shop scene was created by Alex Treviño from a concept by Anaïs
Maamar. The source describes the work as Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike
(CC BY-SA). Preserve this attribution and apply the same license family to
redistributions and adaptations.

The artist's page for the work identifies its CC BY-SA license:
<https://aendom.artstation.com/projects/NAA5z>. The available evidence does not
establish the license version. The source artifact and unresolved version are
recorded in the fixture provenance file. The Creative Commons license-family
page is <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/>.
